name: mpi-kanban
description: MPI workflow skills (init, project-setup, project-mode, project-refresh, brainstorm, create-plan, create-large-plan, continue, execute-parallel, handoff, end-session, cleanup, archive, brief-rule) bundled as a plugin that drives a per-project Kanban board and durable project knowledge.

interface.shortDescription: MPI planning, handoff, cleanup, and kanban workflows for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Mpi-Kanban bundles the MPI workflow skills for Codex-native use while sharing the same Markdown workflow source as the Claude Code plugin. It drives a project kanban board and shared agent coordination state.
